import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    g = t*np.exp(-params[5]*t)
    return (params[0]+params[1]*g)*P + params[2]*P**2 + (params[3]+params[4]*g)/P + params[6]*t + params[7]*np.sqrt(t) + params[8]
